title.zh: 纽约州博彩委员会起诉Kalshi，要求法院强制执行调查传票
title.en: 纽约州博彩委员会起诉Kalshi，要求法院强制执行调查传票

current_state.zh: New York State Gaming Commission filed suit in state Supreme Court to force Kalshi to comply with a July 31 subpoena covering sports event contracts, under-21 users, betting-related advertising, and ownership structure, as part of a broader regulatory dispute seeking civil penalties.
current_state.en: New York State Gaming Commission filed suit in state Supreme Court to force Kalshi to comply with a July 31 subpoena covering sports event contracts, under-21 users, betting-related advertising, and ownership structure, as part of a broader regulatory dispute seeking civil penalties.
